queries: WITH indexed AS (SELECT rfistat, modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM indexed), status_avgs AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM indexed GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, s.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_average FROM status_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_average, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
